title: Cutover on Sunday 16 November, evening
description: Monday's first wave runs on the new system; Monday-morning cutovers go wrong.
quote: a cutover on Sunday the sixteenth in the evening, so Monday's morning wave already runs on the new system.

title: Paper runsheets as the fallback in week one
quote: For the first week I want paper runsheets as a fallback. If the system is down, the drivers still leave on time.
Jonas says the bulk run fixed about eighty percent. My team is checking the industrial park addresses by hand.
note: ~80% geocoded; the rest checked by hand

title: Is 80% geocoded enough to say go for Antwerp?
quote: Is eighty percent enough to say go on the twelfth? I'd like Tom's view on that.

title: Brief the night shift lead before the go/no-go
quote: Please brief him before the go/no-go, he should be in that meeting.
He's been on leave, he's back on Monday.

title: Update the cutover plan and send it round
quote: I'll update the cutover plan with Sunday evening and the paper fallback and send it round tonight.
